verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a cloud browser platform that stores session logs, replays and downloaded files, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion APIs or data-lifecycle controls. The Downloads API and session replay are about retrieving and observing data, not about controlling how long it is kept or deleting it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
